active_listing_count.label: Active listings
active_listing_count.definition: Average number of listings in active for-sale status on a typical day during the month, excluding pending listings where pending status is available.

new_listing_count.label: New listings
new_listing_count.definition: Number of listings newly added to the market during the month. Year-over-year comparison is emphasized because listing activity is seasonal.

pending_ratio.label: Pending-to-active ratio
pending_ratio.definition: Pending listing count divided by active listing count for the ZIP code during the month. Availability depends on consistent pending-status reporting.

hotness_score.label: Market Hotness score
hotness_score.definition: Realtor.com composite of equally weighted demand and supply scores. It ranks buyer attention and market speed relative to other ZIP codes; it is not an absolute probability of sale.

viewer_ratio.label: Listing viewers relative to U.S.
viewer_ratio.definition: Unique viewers received by a typical property in the ZIP code divided by viewers received by a typical U.S. property in the same month.

demand_score.label: Hotness demand score
demand_score.definition: Relative index based on unique listing viewers per property; used as one half of Realtor.com's Market Hotness score.

supply_score.label: Hotness supply score
supply_score.definition: Relative index based on median days on market; used as one half of Realtor.com's Market Hotness score.

realtor_median_dom.label: Realtor.com median days on market
realtor_median_dom.definition: Median time between a listing's initial listing date and its closing or removal date, as used in Realtor.com's Hotness supply component.
